inquiry.subject: Smoke + burning smell FH-G7
inquiry.body: Running late so short version of a long day. Power went out on our road Thursday and I fired up the FH-G7 for the well pump and the fridge. Ran fine for the first hour, then I plugged in the space heater and the welder cord since I figured it could handle it, and about ten minutes later there was a hot electrical smell and a thin line of smoke coming off the control panel. I killed it and walked away. It's cooling in the shed now. Anyway what I actually need to know is what could cause that and if I can get the panel looked at or replaced. The warranty paperwork is somewhere in the truck. Serial is FH-G7-23-01954, I think, the sticker is half scratched. We still have no power at the house so please get back to me on my cell or email. Thanks.

retrieved.title: FH-G7 Troubleshooting: No Power at the Outlets
retrieved.heading: Safety first
retrieved.text: This guide covers an FH-G7 portable generator that runs but gives no power at the outlets. Never open the control panel while the engine runs. If you smell burning or see smoke from the control panel, shut off the engine, unplug everything, and do not run the unit again. Stop using the FH-G7 and contact Fernhollow.

retrieved.title: FH-G7 Troubleshooting: Will Not Start or Shuts Off
retrieved.heading: Safety first
retrieved.text: This guide covers an FH-G7 portable generator that will not start or shuts off. Use the generator outdoors only, because it makes carbon monoxide. If you see fuel leaking, smoke, or fire, or if you smell fuel strongly, stop using the FH-G7 and contact Fernhollow.

retrieved.title: FH-G7 Portable Generator Owner's Manual
retrieved.heading: Carbon monoxide warning
retrieved.text: The FH-G7 makes carbon monoxide, a gas that has no smell and can kill. Use the generator outdoors only. Put it at least 20 feet from windows, doors, and vents. Never run it in a garage, a basement, a shed, or near an open window. If you feel dizzy, sick, or weak while the generator runs, move to fresh air and get medical help. Stop using the generator and contact Fernhollow.
